This is a non-official evidence assessment, not a definitive determination of homology or an official SCOPe classification.

**Conclusion**
No. For AF-P02452-F1, UniProt P02452, release 2.08, the retrieved evidence supports only two sequence-hit envelopes, approximately residues 39-96 and 957-1117; it does not justify concluding that the remaining approximately 1,245/1,464 residues have no structural relationships or domains. The absence of returned FATCAT hits is negative retrieved evidence from this run, but the long unhit middle is very low-confidence and the C-terminal unhit region has fragmented high-pLDDT clusters, so “no FATCAT hits” is not evidence of absence.

**What can be said at each level**

Region 39-96:
| Level | Assessment and ambiguity | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Function | Target function is not established from this evidence; the retrieved representative’s VWC label is reference context only. | E2, E5 |
| Family | A VWC-domain family candidate is favored by one sequence hit, but without FATCAT support it is not family-confirmed. | E2, E5 |
| Superfamily | FnI-like/VWC superfamily context is consistent with the sequence hit, with the same no-structure-hit limitation. | E2, E5 |
| Fold | No structural relationship is established by returned FATCAT evidence for this region. | E3, E5 |

Region 957-1117:
| Level | Assessment and ambiguity | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Function | Target function is not established; collagen-fibre reference classification alone does not transfer function. | E1, E4 |
| Family | Collagen fibre family candidate is supported by a significant sequence-hit group, but the three raw hits are redundant by overlap-SCCS grouping and there are no returned FATCAT hits. | E1, E4 |
| Superfamily | Collagen fibre superfamily context is consistent with the sequence group, but confidence is low and structural corroboration is absent. | E1, E4 |
| Fold | No structural relationship is established by returned FATCAT evidence for this region. | E3, E4 |

Remaining ranges 1-38, 97-956, and 1118-1464:
| Level | Assessment and ambiguity | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Function | Not established by retrieved evidence. | E3, E6 |
| Family | Not established by retrieved sequence/FATCAT evidence; this is not evidence that no family-level relationship exists. | E3, E6 |
| Superfamily | Not established by retrieved evidence. | E3, E6 |
| Fold | Not established by returned FATCAT evidence; confidence patterns, especially high-pLDDT clusters in 1118-1464, prevent treating the unhit remainder as proven domain-free. | E3, E6 |

**Evidence considered**
- **E1** — Sequence-hit stream has 4 raw hits but 2 reported overlap-SCCS groups. The collagen fibre group has representative d3hqva_, rank 1, SCCS i.25.1.1, residues 957-1117 aligned to 795-955, 161/1464 model residues = 11.0%, log10 E-value -33.19, identity 7.23%, and group size 3. This supports a collagen-fibre candidate over 957-1117 but the group is correlated, not three independent regional observations. Source: [d3hqva_ sequence hit](https://brass.lbl.gov/~makelyan/scop-test/scop-newui-php-bootstrap/alphafold/af_x_domains/index.php?af=AF-P02452-F1&mode=seq&hit=d3hqva_)
- **E2** — The second sequence group is d1u5ma1, rank 3, SCCS g.27.1.2, residues 39-96 aligned to 5-62, 58/1464 model residues = 3.96%, log10 E-value -19.06, identity 5.22%, group size 1. This supports a separate N-terminal VWC/FnI-like candidate over 39-96. Source: [d1u5ma1 sequence hit](https://brass.lbl.gov/~makelyan/scop-test/scop-newui-php-bootstrap/alphafold/af_x_domains/index.php?af=AF-P02452-F1&mode=seq&hit=d1u5ma1)
- **E3** — The structure-hit stream returned 0 raw FATCAT hits and 0 reported groups at limit 100. This means no returned FATCAT evidence supports a structural relationship, but it does not prove absence of structural relationships or domains outside the sequence-hit regions. Source: [hit summary](http://127.0.0.1:18777/api/v1/index.php/releases/2.08/alphafolds/AF-P02452-F1/hits?limit=100)
- **E4** — d3hqva_ lineage is Low resolution protein structures class i, Collagen fibre fold i.25/SUNID 144296, superfamily i.25.1/SUNID 144297, family i.25.1.1/SUNID 144298. The matched model region has low confidence: median pLDDT 43.87, bands 0.0% >=90, 0.0% 70-<90, 18.63% 50-<70, 81.37% <50, with a sustained <70 stretch spanning 947-1127. This weakens any structure-dependent interpretation for 957-1117. Sources: [family node](https://scop.berkeley.edu/sunid=144298&ver=2.08), [confidence/provenance](http://127.0.0.1:18777/api/v1/index.php/releases/2.08/alphafolds/AF-P02452-F1)
- **E5** — d1u5ma1 lineage is Small proteins class g, FnI-like domain fold g.27/SUNID 57602, superfamily g.27.1/SUNID 57603, VWC domain family g.27.1.2/SUNID 118264. The matched model region has local median pLDDT 82.0, bands 13.79% >=90, 70.69% 70-<90, 15.52% 50-<70, 0.0% <50, with lower-confidence flanks. This makes the local geometry more interpretable than the collagen-fibre interval, but there is still no FATCAT corroboration. Sources: [family node](https://scop.berkeley.edu/sunid=118264&ver=2.08), [confidence/provenance](http://127.0.0.1:18777/api/v1/index.php/releases/2.08/alphafolds/AF-P02452-F1)
- **E6** — Whole-model confidence is mixed and mostly low: global pLDDT 54.69; whole-model median 44.5 with bands 15.03% >=90, 4.99% 70-<90, 13.52% 50-<70, 66.46% <50. The unhit intervals cover 1-38, 97-956, and 1118-1464, together 1,245/1,464 residues = 85.04%; 97-956 is very low confidence, but 1118-1464 has median pLDDT 93.38 and multiple high-pLDDT clusters. This combination leaves unreturned domains or relationships unresolved, not excluded. Source: [confidence/provenance](http://127.0.0.1:18777/api/v1/index.php/releases/2.08/alphafolds/AF-P02452-F1)
- **E7** — Sequence provenance is available for the exact UniProt-linked sequence: UniProt accession P02452 is available, sequence_id is available, source is af_model.uniprot_id, stored BLAST status is stored_blast_results_available, stored BLAST row count is 45, with 4 qualifying raw sequence hits and 2 compact returned groups. This supports treating the four sequence hits as filtered/redundancy-collapsed evidence rather than as a missing-query failure. Source: [hit summary](http://127.0.0.1:18777/api/v1/index.php/releases/2.08/alphafolds/AF-P02452-F1/hits?limit=100)

**Caveats by evidence item**
- **E1** — The three collagen-fibre raw hits are grouped by exact SCCS and overlapping query range; they should not be counted as independent support. Coverage is local, 161/1464 residues, and no exact domain boundary is inferred.
- **E2** — The N-terminal hit is short, 58/1464 residues, and sequence-only. The representative carries a “splice isoform 2” comment, which is reference annotation, not a target-function statement.
- **E3** — Empty FATCAT results are a retrieval result, not a proof of no structural relationship. No FATCAT score, RMSD, chain-benchmark applicability, or calibration exists to interpret for this target because there are no returned structure hits; no calibration threshold was prescribed.
- **E4** — The 957-1117 region is dominated by pLDDT <50, so predicted geometry is weak evidence even if a structural comparison had been returned. Missing PAE/pTM prevents assessing domain packing or relative placement from pLDDT alone.
- **E5** — The 39-96 region has moderate-to-high local confidence but low-confidence flanks, so boundaries remain approximate and confidence does not upgrade sequence evidence to a structural or official classification claim.
- **E6** — The unhit remainder includes both very low-confidence sequence and a high-confidence C-terminal region with fragmented high-pLDDT clusters. pLDDT clusters do not define a fold or boundary, but they make a blanket “no domains in the rest” conclusion especially unsupported.
- **E7** — AlphaFold sequence/template dependence and stored BLAST filtering can correlate sequence and predicted-structure evidence; no target function, ligand state, assembly context, exact homology, or official SCOPe classification is established.
